outlooks.issuedAtBasis: Timestamp of the numerical weather prediction model run, issued before the target window.
outlooks.confidence: This forecast covers days 1 to 7 ahead. The method was tested only on forecasts made 3 and 5 days ahead, on days from 17 Jul 2026 to 17 Oct 2026: at 3 days ahead, 45% of the days it flagged crossed the line (11% of days did anyway) and it flagged 59% of the days that crossed; at 5 days ahead, 41% of the days it flagged crossed the line (11% of days did anyway) and it flagged 54% of the days that crossed. Days beyond 5 ahead were not tested. Those are day-by-day rates; this forecast is graded on its whole window.
outlooks.details: Our own forecast, made before the period it covers. Forecast daily highs, corrected by 1.2 °C for the difference between the forecast service and the 30-year record, reach this place's 95th percentile for the time of year on 7 days in a row, and its 99th on at least one. That line is moved up 0.4 °C for the warming this place's record shows since its middle year. 18 Nov: 27 °C against this place's 1-in-20-day level of 24.2 °C. 19 Nov: 25.8 °C against this place's 1-in-20-day level of 24.2 °C. 20 Nov: 26 °C against this place's 1-in-20-day level of 24.2 °C. 21 Nov: 25.8 °C against this place's 1-in-20-day level of 24.2 °C. 22 Nov: 26.3 °C against this place's 1-in-20-day level of 24.2 °C. 23 Nov: 25.5 °C against this place's 1-in-20-day level of 24.3 °C. 24 Nov: 25.4 °C against this place's 1-in-20-day level of 24.3 °C.
outlooks.evidence: Open-Meteo forecast issued for 2026-11-17, compared with NASA POWER daily records for Lima, Lima Province, Peru, 1996-2025. Bias measured over 21 shared days.
outlooks.verificationRule: Checked against the daily maximum temperature NASA POWER measured for the grid cell around Lima on these days, once each measurement has settled (14 days): correct if the line was crossed on at least one day of the window, a false alarm if it was not. It is not checked against reported disasters.
